dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) API catalogue entry
data_date: service described by catalogue as updated daily; accessed 2026-10-06
evidence_slice: GOV.UK API Catalogue publishes Historic England's National Heritage List for England (NHLE) API as an official public no-login ArcGIS FeatureServer. The catalogue states that the service contains points and polygons for Listed Buildings, uses EPSG:27700, is updated daily, is licensed under the Open Government Licence, and gives the official FeatureServer endpoint. This catalogue record is service-level metadata only: it does not return an individual Exeter listed-building feature, record-bound Name/type-use value, or polygon coordinates.

field_evidence.footprint: The catalogue confirms listed-building polygons and the official FeatureServer endpoint, but this service-metadata window exposes no record-level Exeter polygon coordinates.
field_evidence.type_use: The catalogue exposes no individual Exeter listed-building feature, Name, or record-bound type/use value.
field_evidence.heritage: The catalogue identifies the official NHLE register/API, British National Grid spatial reference, listed-building polygon coverage, daily updates, and Open Government Licence.
